changes.name: Postman（ブログ）
changes.diff_text:
+Can Postman do load testing? Yes, here’s how it works
+Giridhar
+Postman load testing reuses your existing collections with virtual users. Run locally or in the cloud, gate CI on p95, skip the second suite.
+Read more →
+Adding a New Service with the Context Graph and Claude Code
+Talia Kohan
+See how Claude Code uses Postman’s Context Graph and plugin skills to map API dependencies, then wire tests, CI, and a monitor into one pass.
+Read more →
-Introducing Code-Based Mocks in Postman
-Kartik Jain
-Code-based mocks are mock servers written in JavaScript. They remember state, fail on demand, and your agent can create, run, and deploy them from the terminal.
-Read more →
-Steer Your Agents Until They Steer Themselves
-Rohan Vaidya
-How we built an AI agent platform for enterprise GTM: deployments each team can steer, measured improvement, and evals for non-verifiable domains.
-Read more →
